about_the_game:
Step into the paws of Kitty, a determined feline chef with big dreams and even bigger challenges in Kitty Can Cook — a fast-paced cooking game where speed, precision, and a bit of feline flair are the key ingredients for success.

In this delightful kitchen chaos, you'll chop, fry, mix, and plate your way through an evolving menu of recipes like sushi, burgers, ice cream, and more — each with its own set of ingredients all while delivering to impatient animal clientele. From picky bear food critics to excitable monkey fans, every shift brings a new flurry of orders to master.

But it’s not just about cooking. With limited kitchen space and the clock always ticking, you’ll need to manage your stations efficiently and prioritize your actions wisely. Can you grab the Go-Box, assemble the dish, and deliver the meals before time runs out?

Each round introduces new ingredients, tougher combinations, and frantic challenges as Kitty climbs the culinary ladder. Master each recipe to unlock new recipes, fun accessories, new animal chefs, and intense challenge runs that test your reflexes and planning skills.

Whether you're aiming for a high score or just trying to keep up with the lunchtime rush, Kitty Can Cook offers a playful, pressure-cooked blend of strategy and speed — all served with a side of adorable chaos.

This demo includes a partial tutorial and 1 full day playing the normal game
